businessProblem: Sears Holdings reports Q1 2018 comparable store sales down 11.9% overall and 13.4% for Sears Domestic. Store closures continuing. Company relying on asset sales to fund operations. Underlying operating decline unresolved. Diagnose root causes and recommend highest-priority action plan before bankruptcy.

evidence.finding: Q1 2018 total comparable store sales down 11.9% year-over-year per SEC filing
evidence.source: Sears Holdings SEC Q1 2018 earnings release

evidence.finding: Sears Domestic comparable store sales down 13.4% in Q1 2018 per SEC filing
evidence.source: Sears Holdings SEC Q1 2018 earnings release

evidence.finding: Company using asset sales and financial transactions to fund operations — substituting asset monetization for operational improvement
Debt and liquidity pressure limiting available investment for operational improvement
Store closures contributing to revenue decline but not resolving the comparable sales decline in remaining stores
Sustained underinvestment in store experience and customer value proposition
Omnichannel capability weak relative to e-commerce and department-store competitors
No clear operating turnaround plan — strategy primarily asset monetization and store closures without competitive repositioning

ownerConstraintProfile.managementCapability: LOW — unable to reverse structural operating decline
ownerConstraintProfile.keyPersonDependency: HIGH — major shareholder-management overlap created accountability weakness
ownerConstraintProfile.accountabilityWeakness: CRITICAL — asset monetization substituting for operational accountability
